mapper.sql: FROM dm_auth_user u INNER JOIN dm_auth_user p ON p.id = u.parent_id WHERE u.access_key = #{accessKeyId} AND CAST(u.access_key AS BINARY) = CAST(#{accessKeyId} AS BINARY) AND u.account_type = 'SUB_ACCOUNT' AND u.disable = 0 AND p.account_type = 'PRIMARY_ACCOUNT' AND p.disable = 0
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO dm_openapi_nonce (access_key_id, nonce_hash, expire_time_ms) SELECT u.access_key, #{nonceHash}, #{expireTimeMs}
AND #{expireTimeMs} >= UNIX_TIMESTAMP(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) * 1000
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM dm_openapi_nonce WHERE expire_time_ms < UNIX_TIMESTAMP(CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(3)) * 1000 ORDER BY expire_time_ms LIMIT #{limit}
